## Potions

| Potion | Effect |
|---|---|
| Serpent's Blood | Randomly restores 1-25 HP |
| Shield Potion | Generates a shield equivalent to lost HP, up to 50. |
| Holy Water | Randomly Removes one curse. |
| Reforge Potion | Reforges all spells in the inventory. Note, this is only spells in the Backpack, not on wands. |
| Illusion Potion | Slows down time for 12 sec. |
| Awakening Potion | Temporarily increases MP regenration for your wands by 200% for 10 sec. |
| Refresh Potion | Refreshes purchasable items and accessible doors in all rooms. |
| Lockpick Potion | Unlocks all locked objects in the current room. Note, can be used to safely open a cursed chest without receiving the curse. |
| Midas Potion | Transforms all non-boss enemies in the room into coins. |
| Discount Potion | Applies a discount to all purchasable items in the current room. |
| Levitation Potion | You're levitating! Lasts until you enter the next door. |
| Invisibility Potion | Grants invisibility for 12 sec; attacks won't reveal you. |
| Invincibility Potion | Grants invincibility for 8 sec. |
| Petrification Potion | Petrifies yourself, granting immunity to all DMG for 30 sec but you are unable to fire wands. Movement will end Petrification. |
| Agility Potion | Permanently increases movement speed by 0.6. |
| Scale Potion | Permanently alters your body size. |
| Crystal Potion | Permanently increases MP regenration by 1. |
| Unstable Red Potion | Permanently increases Max HP by -5 or 15. |
| Unstable Blue Potion | Permanently increases Max MP by -5 or 15. |
| Purification Potion | Removes all curses. Lose all coins, keys, and shield. |
| Wealth Potion | Gains coins equal to 25% of the coins currently in possession. |
| Tears Of the Goddess | Removes all curses if 5 different curses are present. Note: counts curse symbols, not curses acquired. |
| Relic Potion | Randomly upgrades one relic. If no relic can be upgraded, receive a common relic. |
| Reset Potion | Resets one chosen relic. Note: you choose the relic, not the game. |
| Sacrificial Potion | Deducts 20% of current HP to gain a corresponding amount of coins. |
| Locksmith Potion | Doubles current key count or adds 1 keys if none are owned. |
| Pure Castor Oil | Grants immunity to poison and slime in the current room. Inflicts poison and slows enemies behind for 10 sec. Note: Potion will cause you to move towards the cursor for the 10 seconds of damaging enemies. |
| Duplication Potion | Duplicates all HP recovery, shield, coin, and keys from the current room. |
| Treasure Potion | Obtains a random treasure chest. |
| Emergency Potion | Grants a temporary shield equivalent to your lost HP. Note: The temporary shield goes away when entering the next room. |
| Conversion Potion | Deducts 40% of current HP to gain a corresponding amount of shield. |
